title: Canada Trade War Complicates Republican Senate Campaigns in Swing States
detail: Trump's ongoing trade war with Canada is straining Republican Senate campaigns, as swing-state voters in manufacturing and agricultural districts grow increasingly sensitive to tariff-driven price increases. Candidates in key battleground states are struggling to defend tariff policy as costs rise for consumers and businesses ahead of the November midterms.

media.caption: Trump's Canada trade war complicating Republican Senate races
